data.long_meaning: The name Shawna is derived from the Old English word scēowan, meaning 'to shine' or 'to show'. In Christian tradition, it is believed to be a variant of the name Shauna, which has its roots in the Hebrew name Shau'na, meaning 'graceful gift'. The name carries the symbolism of divine blessings, beauty, and the gift of life.
